related_questions.question: Is the COVID booster free at CVS?
related_questions.snippet: Is the COVID-19 vaccine free? The COVID-19 vaccine is available at no cost through most insurance plans, including Medicare Part B. CVS Pharmacy® and MinuteClinic® can directly bill many national and regional health plans that cover all or part of the cost of a flu shot.
related_questions.title: No-cost COVID-19 vaccines for you and your family - CVS

related_questions.question: Does it matter what type of COVID booster you get?
related_questions.snippet: There is no preference for one vaccine over the other when more than one vaccine is recommended for an age group. The 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccines more closely target the JN.1 lineage of the Omicron variant. 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccines are updated to give you the best protection from the currently circulating strains.

related_questions.question: When can I have a booster for COVID?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine should usually be offered no earlier than around 6 months after the last vaccine dose. If you are eligible, you can get protection from an autumn COVID-19 vaccination even if you have not taken up a COVID-19 vaccine offer in the past.
